block.comment: Wait for the given number of milliseconds (1000 ms = 1 second). This pauses the main program; avoid long waits when loop must service motors, music files or serial input.

Purpose: Show a greeting on a 16×2 HD44780 LCD with PCF8574 I2C backpack. Check address and contrast first. Wiring: HD44780 I2C LCD: address 0x27; I2C SDA A4, SCL A5. Common GND; use each module’s required supply. Try: Edit the two text values. Row 0 is the first line; row 1 is the second.
